kelime: لا ناقة له فيه ولا جمل

kaikki_vikisozluk.w: لا ناقة له فيه ولا جمل
kaikki_vikisozluk.u: لا ناقة له فيه ولا جمل
kaikki_vikisozluk.e: لَا ناقةَ لَهُ فِيهِ وَلَا جَمَلَ • (lā nāqata lahu fīhi walā jamala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Literally, “he has neither a female nor a male camel in it”. Attributed to a 6th-century conflict in the Arabian peninsula known as the Basus War.
s: “he has neither a female nor a male camel in it”
Literally, “he has neither a female nor a male camel in it”
g: having no connection or benefit to it, it does not concern him; he is not affected by it; he is indifferent about it
r: lā nāqata lahu fīhi walā jamala
